hypotheses: Conflict interpretation: the supplied evidence supports neither a clean late-cycle bearish break nor an unambiguously healthy continuation. It is more coherently described as cross-horizon consolidation with a short-term downside-fragility signal.

Premature late-cycle bearishness would be falsified only if the negative short-horizon price/flow behavior persists and becomes aligned with broader deterioration, rather than remaining isolated against positive 24-hour/72-hour returns and improved proxy breadth.
